common_assertions: [C1] The Skill was loaded (Skill call or `SKILL.md` read) before the first change to `CHANGELOG.md` or the Changelog policy, and before the final report.
[C2] When the policy file exists at the start, the run read it before it changed or reviewed `CHANGELOG.md`.
[C3] No new commit. `git diff --cached` is empty.
[C4] No file changed except `CHANGELOG.md` and the Changelog policy; in test 48, `HISTORY.md` is renamed to `CHANGELOG.md`.

[C5] When `CHANGELOG.md` changed: the lines that this run wrote follow every §2 rule and each Setting of the run's policy (Unreleased items need no commit reference; `Host: none` items need no references). Old lines are unchanged unless the request asked for it.

[C6] The final report names each changed file and lists each Review finding with line numbers, rule and § number, severity, and a fix; findings with the same rule and fix are one finding with all their line numbers. Or it says why nothing changed.

evals.name: 17-conflict-unreleased
evals.prompt: Add a changelog entry: fix `slugify` keeping leading spaces (pull request #6).

steps:
cat > CHANGELOG.md <<'EOF'
# Changelog

## Unreleased

### Added

- Add `truncate()` to shorten long titles ([#5](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/5)) (Alice)

<<<<<<< HEAD
### Fixed

- Fix `slugify()` dropping accented letters ([#6](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/6)) (Bob)
=======
### Changed

- Round `formatPrice()` results to 2 decimals ([#7](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/7)) (Dave)
>>>>>>> feature/price

## [1.2.0] - 2026-09-01

### Added

- Add `formatPrice()` ([`3f2a9c1`](https://github.com/example/demo/commit/3f2a9c1)) (Carol)
- Add `slugify()` ([`8d4e7b2`](https://github.com/example/demo/commit/8d4e7b2)) (Carol)

[1.2.0]: https://github.com/example/demo/releases/tag/v1.2.0
EOF

assertions: [17.1] `CHANGELOG.md` has no conflict markers (`<<<<<<<`, `=======`, `>>>>>>>`).

[17.2] The Unreleased section keeps the items of both sides of the conflict: `formatPrice()` rounding (#7, Dave), `truncate()` (#5, Alice), and `slugify()` accented letters (#6, Bob), with their text, references, and authors unchanged.
[17.3] The Unreleased section has the groups in the sequence `### Changed`, `### Added`, `### Fixed`, with one heading for each group.
[17.4] One new item about `slugify` and leading spaces is in `### Fixed` of the Unreleased section, with the linked reference `[#6](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/6)` and no commit reference.
[17.5] The `## [1.2.0] - 2026-09-01` entry and its link definition are unchanged.

## Unreleased

## [1.2.1] - 2026-09-22

### Added

- Add \`truncate()\` to shorten long titles ([\`$s5\`](https://github.com/example/demo/commit/$s5)) ([#5](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/5)) (Alice)

### Fixed

- Fix \`slugify()\` dropping accented letters and keeping leading spaces ([\`$s6\`](https://github.com/example/demo/commit/$s6)) ([#6](https://github.com/example/demo/pull/6)) (Bob)

## [1.2.0] - 2026-09-01

### Added

- Add \`formatPrice()\` ([\`3f2a9c1\`](https://github.com/example/demo/commit/3f2a9c1)) (Carol)
- Add \`slugify()\` ([\`8d4e7b2\`](https://github.com/example/demo/commit/8d4e7b2)) (Carol)

[1.2.1]: https://github.com/example/demo/releases/tag/v1.2.1
[1.2.0]: https://github.com/example/demo/releases/tag/v1.2.0
